'''House a'Conn''' is a house from [[Murandy]]. 

Its only known member is Lord [[Paitr do Fearna a'Conn]], one of the heads of the Murandian delegation that meets with [[Andor]]an nobility and the [[Salidar]] [[Rebel Aes Sedai|Aes Sedai]] on the Feast of Abram.{{ref/book|8|17}}
